redemption_instructions_by_platform.0:
Redeem the code below on the Apex Legends redemption page to access your reward.

Codes are not platform specific and are redeemed from within the Apex Legends Storefront.  
1. Boot Apex Legends on your platform of choice.  
2. When on the lobby screen select [Store].  
3. Select [Redeem Code] on the bottom left.  
4. Enter the code you received.  
5. Select [Redeem].

redemption_instructions_by_platform.0:
"How to Redeem:
Visit the official Honkai: Star Rail website's redemption page (https://hsr.hoyoverse.com/gift), log in to your game account, and follow the instructions to enter the code. Once redeemed, the rewards will be sent via in-game mail.

Reward Contents: Stellar Jade ×30, Credit ×20,000, Lost Gold Fragment ×4, Condensed Aether ×5, Traveler's Guide ×3.

Note: Rewards are limited. Rewards will be distributed in the order that the redemption codes are claimed after completing the quest, on a first-come, first-served basis.

* The redemption code will expire on 2026/12/21 11:00:00 (UTC+8). We highly recommend redeeming it as soon as possible."
